official.deadline_note: Master's application form (which carries the scholarship question) closes 5 January 2027 at 15.00 (UTC +2), document deadline 12 January 2027 at 15.00 (UTC +2); English-taught bachelor's admission rounds A and B run 7-22 January 2027. A scholarship must be applied for during the application period and cannot be applied for afterwards.
official.application_cycle: 2027 intake: master's programmes beginning autumn 2027 (application 7 December 2026 - 5 January 2027); bachelor's programmes in English beginning autumn 2027 (application 7-22 January 2027)
official.status_note: Aalto's published schedule states the application period for master's programmes beginning in autumn 2027 runs from 7 December 2026 to 5 January 2027, so the 2027 round had not yet opened at the time of verification (10 October 2026).
official.tuition_coverage_note: Aalto University Excellence Scholarships are awarded as tuition fee waivers that cover the full tuition fee. The tuition fee covers educational expenses such as courses, academic supervision, exams, counselling and university support services such as student services, library services and IT services; it does not cover living costs, personal study-related costs or the compulsory Student Union membership fee.
official.funding_period: per academic year for the normative period of study
benefits: 100% tuition fee waiver: the scholarship covers the full tuition fee for the normative period of study

Published tuition fees the waiver covers (rights to study beginning on or after 1 August 2025): bachelor's EUR 12,000 per academic year in Business and Technology, EUR 15,000 in Art and Architecture; master's EUR 15,000 in Business, EUR 17,000 in Technology and in multidisciplinary programmes, EUR 20,000 in Art and Architecture
The scholarship also applies during an exchange period or internship abroad at another university
The scholarship decision is given at the same time as the admission decision

An Aalto bachelor's graduate who held the Excellence Scholarship and completed the degree within the target time with a weighted average grade of at least 3.5 receives a 100% tuition fee waiver for the normative duration of the master's degree
eligibility: Applicants liable to pay tuition fees at Aalto University, i.e. most non-EU/EEA citizens applying to an English-taught bachelor's or master's programme
EU/EEA citizens are not eligible: they do not pay tuition fees and therefore cannot receive the tuition fee waiver

The scholarship must be applied for during the application period by ticking the scholarship option on the admission application form; it cannot be applied for afterwards and cannot be granted if not applied for
Applicants admitted from the waiting list cannot receive a scholarship, as scholarship decisions are finalised before admission results are released
Scholarship candidates are screened against the EU sanctions lists; scholarships are not awarded to individuals on those lists
Holders of certain fee-exempting Finnish residence permits (permanent P, P-EU, EU Blue Card and similar) are not liable to tuition fees and so cannot receive the waiver
requirements: Submit the admission application form in the Studyinfo.fi service during the application period and tick the option to apply for the scholarship
Pay the EUR 100 application fee if not an EU/EEA or Swiss citizen and not holding a fee-exempting document; payment within seven days of submitting the form, no waivers available
Upload all obligatory application documents by the document deadline, 12 January 2027 at 15.00 (UTC +2) for the 2027 master's round

Meet the general eligibility criteria: a bachelor's degree giving eligibility for master's level education (master's applicants), an accepted proof of English proficiency, and all required documents submitted by the deadline
Holders must study full-time and make steady progress according to the approved personal study plan
documents: Bachelor's degree certificate (a provisional certificate with the same details is accepted; for the 2027 round completion no later than 31 July 2027)
Official transcript of study records for the bachelor's degree, all pages, listing individual courses, grades, credits and completion dates
Authorised translations of the degree certificate and transcript if they are not in English, Finnish or Swedish
Copy of passport or official government-issued photo ID showing citizenship
Accepted proof of English language proficiency, e.g. IELTS Academic overall 6.5 with writing 6.0, or TOEFL iBT, PTE Academic, Cambridge C1 Advanced/C2 Proficiency or YKI as published
Portfolio (study options in art, design and architecture) and GMAT/GRE score report sent electronically by the test administrator (School of Business admission group 2)
selection_criteria: Awarded on a competitive basis to the highest-achieving applicants based on the study option's evaluation criteria
In master's admissions, scholarships are allocated during the academic evaluation stage as part of the admissions process of a degree programme
Applicants are ranked according to the evaluation criteria indicated on the study option's webpage
The number of scholarships per degree programme is highly limited and programmes may decide not to grant any scholarships
Applying for a scholarship does not affect the chances of admission
The scholarship decision cannot be appealed
coverage: 100% of the tuition fee (full tuition fee waiver) for the normative period of study
Tuition fee covers educational expenses: courses, academic supervision, exams, counselling and university support services such as student services, library and IT services
Living costs are not covered: students must cover all living expenses (at least 800 euros per month) and other study-related costs from their own financial resources
No travel, relocation or installation costs are covered
The compulsory Student Union (AYY) membership fee and the Kela student healthcare fee are not covered by the tuition fee
application_method: Tick the scholarship option on the Aalto admission application form in the Studyinfo.fi service during the application period; there is no separate scholarship application
After admission, agree to the terms of the scholarship by the given deadline and accept the study place bindingly
official.application_route: Apply to the degree programme through the Studyinfo.fi application form during the application period and tick the scholarship option; the scholarship decision is issued with the admission decision.
official.citizenship_residency: Liable to pay tuition fees, i.e. not a citizen of an EU/EEA member state or Switzerland and holding no fee-exempting Finnish residence permit; EU/EEA citizens cannot receive the waiver
official.international_eligibility: Yes - the scholarship is open only to fee-liable international (non-EU/EEA/Swiss) applicants
official.subject_or_agency_requirement: Open to applicants of all English-taught bachelor's and master's programmes; certain international joint degree programmes have their own tuition fees and scholarship schemes
official.duration: Normative period of study: three academic years full-time for a bachelor's degree and two academic years full-time for a master's degree; the scholarship requires full-time study and progress according to the approved personal study plan
official.description: Aalto University offers a very limited number of scholarships to fee-paying students in the form of tuition fee waivers. Aalto University Excellence Scholarships are merit-based and are granted on a competitive basis to the highest-achieving applicants based on the programme's evaluation criteria; programmes may decide not to grant any scholarships. The scholarship covers the full tuition fee for the normative period of study but not living costs, and it is applied for inside the admission application form during the application period.
official.program_type: Merit-based tuition fee waiver awarded with admission
official.english_requirement: Master's programmes taught in English require an accepted proof of English proficiency: IELTS Academic overall 6.5 with writing 6.0; TOEFL iBT taken on or after 21 January 2026 with total 4.5 and 4.0 in all subtests (tests before that date: total 92 with writing 22); PTE Academic overall 68 with writing 61; Cambridge C1 Advanced grade A, B or C, or C2 Proficiency grade A, B, C or Level C1; or Finnish YKI at level 5 in all subtests. Results are valid two years (for 2027 admissions, tests taken on or after 7 December 2024) and official scores must reach Aalto by 12 January 2027 at 15.00 (UTC +2). Exemptions include a higher education degree completed in Finland, an English-medium degree from a listed country completed while residing there, upper secondary education in English in listed countries, Aalto exchange studies, an Aalto Executive Education MBA/EMBA/DBA, or a CEMS MIM. In the English-taught bachelor's programmes in Science and Technology and Business and Economics no official proof of English is required; the Design and Media programme has its own language requirements.

not_confirmed: funding_amount: no single cash figure is published because the waiver equals 100% of the field-specific tuition fee (published at EUR 12,000-20,000 per academic year depending on field and degree level)
number of scholarships per degree programme: published only as a very limited number, with programmes free to award none
document/attachment deadline date for the bachelor's admission rounds of 7-22 January 2027: only the master's document deadline of 12 January 2027 is published on the admissions pages
verification.notes: Verified on Aalto's own aalto.fi pages on 10 October 2026: 100% tuition fee waiver scope with no living-cost coverage, published tuition fees for rights to study beginning on or after 1 August 2025, the 7 December 2026 - 5 January 2027 master's application window with the 12 January 2027 document deadline, the 7-22 January 2027 bachelor's rounds, and the master's English test minima, exemptions and score deadlines.

applicant_utility.summary: This is a tuition-fee eraser, not a stipend: it wipes out Aalto's tuition bill for the whole degree (two years for a master's, three for a bachelor's), worth roughly EUR 24,000-40,000 over a master's depending on your field. You claim it by ticking one box on the same admission application in Studyinfo.fi - there is no separate scholarship form, no essay, and applying does not affect your admission chances. The trap is that you must self-fund living costs of at least EUR 800 per month, both under the scholarship's own terms and to satisfy the Finnish residence permit income requirement.
applicant_utility.best_fit: Academically strong non-EU/EEA applicants to Aalto's English-taught programmes who already have living-cost funding they can document.
application_readiness_checklist: Book IELTS/TOEFL/PTE early enough that the official score reaches Aalto by 12 January 2027; Aalto grants no extensions, not even when the test organiser is late
Order an authorised translation (stamped, by the awarding university or a certified translator) of your degree certificate and transcript now if they are not in English, Finnish or Swedish
Confirm your transcript lists every course with grades, credits and completion dates - screenshots from student portals are rejected
Check your passport validity (an ID expired within 12 months of 7 December 2026 is accepted) and that your name matches your study documents exactly
Pay the EUR 100 application fee within seven days of submitting the form - unpaid applications are not processed even with perfect documents
common_rejection_risks: Documents missing after the document deadline or uploaded to the wrong section - the application is rejected as incomplete with no extension
Language scores arriving late or submitted by the applicant instead of the test administrator (TOEFL and PTE reports must come electronically from ETS or Pearson)
Assuming the scholarship can be added after the application period or after admission - including applicants admitted off the waiting list, who cannot receive one
Submitting an unofficial transcript or offering a Diploma Supplement in place of the degree certificate
School of Business master's applicants whose GMAT/GRE reports were not sent electronically by the test administrator in time
applicant_utility.estimated_uncovered_costs: Living costs of at least EUR 800 per month in the capital region (Aalto's own estimate), plus the compulsory Student Union AYY membership fee (EUR 65 in academic year 2025-2026), the Kela student healthcare fee (EUR 36 per semester in 2026), rent, meals, transport, study materials, insurance and travel to Finland - none of which the scholarship covers.
document_audit: Both the degree certificate and the transcript are obligatory; a Diploma Supplement can replace the transcript only if it lists courses, grades, credits and completion dates, and never replaces the degree certificate
Authorised translations must be issued by the awarding institution or a certified/authorised translator bearing stamp and signature
Each document is a separately named PDF in the correct upload section (e.g. Transcript-lastname-firstname); wrong-section or wrong-file uploads can get the application rejected
If your passport name differs from your study documents, add an official name-change document such as a marriage certificate
When applying to two study options, upload option-specific documents (motivation letter, portfolio) separately for each study option
alerts: Only fee-liable non-EU/EEA nationals can hold this scholarship: if you gain EU/EEA citizenship or an exempting residence permit you lose eligibility, and if your permit status changes mid-studies you must report it to tuitionfees@aalto.fi

Programmes may award no scholarships at all, and in master's admissions scholarships are study-option-specific - a scholarship for your second preference does not transfer to your first preference if you come off the waiting list

If you hold the Aalto bachelor's Excellence Scholarship, graduating within the target time with a weighted average grade of at least 3.5 is what unlocks the master's continuation; a late graduation forfeits it
The scholarship must be accepted by the given deadline after admission and requires full-time study with steady progress on your approved personal study plan
applicant_utility.submission_workflow: Submit the Studyinfo.fi application form with the scholarship option ticked during the 7 December 2026 - 5 January 2027 window, upload all documents by 12 January 2027, then wait: scholarship and admission answers arrive together on 30 March 2027 and the offer must be accepted by 21 April 2027.
